scope: The surviving three-storey principal exterior at 501 Ann Street, known as Callaghan Place after conversion to educational use. Covers the rounded corner entry and tower, the Ann and Boundary Street wings, rear service elevations and roof mass.

originalReview.notes: At the right of the date-stamped archive record, the recognizable rounded tower with angular quoin piers and the strip-windowed flanks show the original three-storey office and warehouse. Studied persistent architectural fabric only.

quallaSearch.notes: The published Qualla gallery was checked first. This is the exact public-domain State Library copy with dated local provenance. The architectural control excludes the contemporary CC-BY/SA photo families and the 1940 printed illustration.
